common_name: Abraham Lincoln Tomato (Classic 1923 Red Beefsteak Heirloom)

planting.note: Start indoors 6-8 weeks before last frost and transplant after all frost risk has passed; this vigorous indeterminate vine benefits from sturdy staking or caging.

directions: Start seed indoors 6-8 weeks before the last frost and transplant into deeply prepared, fertile soil in full sun. Abraham Lincoln is an American heirloom tomato dating to 1923, prized for large, deep-red, meaty beefsteak fruit with rich, well-balanced flavor and good disease tolerance for a variety of its age, which helped it remain popular with home gardeners for decades after its introduction. The vigorous indeterminate vines are strong producers over a long season and benefit from sturdy staking or caging to support the heavy fruit. Water evenly to reduce cracking and blossom end rot, and harvest once fruit is fully colored and yields slightly to gentle pressure for the best flavor.
